findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/pages/Portfolios/Detail/Components/DeliveryGrid/DeliveryCreateModal.test.tsx: it should have Save button disabled for past date
findings.obligation: P1 and P4: a user who types a past launch date sees Save disabled; the render proof of that gating must survive the move
findings.observation: The row selects no feature, so Save is disabled by the no-feature rule as well; the sibling row should have Save button disabled when no features are selected proves that alone. Deleting the date rule leaves this row green, and no unit row or remaining row observes Save gated by a past date. The move list as written deletes the only such observation.
findings.remediation: Remove this row from the moved set. Keep it and select one feature in it, so a past date is the only blocker, then assert Save is disabled. Re-review the corrected move list.
